Fixed the `OrderedSet` representation-dependent behavior.

- `src/Set.js`: iteration now derives set values from backing-map keys. This prevents ordered equality from comparing internal insertion indexes instead of elements.
- `src/Iterator.js`: optimized collection hashing now uses logical map size rather than backing iteration size, so removed entries do not affect an `OrderedSet` hash.
